name: Shadows in the Moonlight
text:
Your commands help your team evade notice. Signal all squadmates within your banner's aura; until the end of your next turn, you and each ally count as Following the Expert for any checks to hide or sneak and can ignore the noisy trait on any armor you wear. If you spend 2 actions to use this tactic, up to two squadmates within your banner's aura can also either Hide or Sneak as a free action.

---
Special If you have this tactic prepared, you can use Warfare Lore in place of Stealth for checks you attempt to Hide and Sneak.
